Users in this group have BOTH source and destination restrictions enforced.
- Can only access warehouses they are explicitly assigned to - Cannot transfer stock to warehouses outside their allowed list - Cannot view or modify inventory in unauthorized warehouses
Exception: Transit warehouses and locations are accessible to all users in this group to facilitate inter-warehouse collaboration.
Use case: Warehouse operators who should only work within their assigned warehouse.

Users in this group have ONLY source restrictions enforced.
- Can only access inventory in warehouses they are assigned to - CAN transfer stock to ANY destination warehouse (no destination restriction) - Cannot view or modify inventory in unauthorized source warehouses
Use case: Regional managers or logistics coordinators who need to redistribute stock from their assigned warehouses to any destination warehouse.
